consequence.statement: The value was always forced to true in reality, so the fix only makes the declared setting match actual behavior and operators need to do nothing.

original.statement: The ztunnel securityContext now explicitly sets allowPrivilegeEscalation to true, matching what was always effectively enforced, so there is no practical runtime change.

decision.reason: [ev-5918eeb14ddb] says `allowPrivilegeEscalation` "has always been forced to `true` in reality". Setting it to `true` in ztunnel therefore only makes the declared value match what already happened at runtime. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected, or behaves differently, so "none" (informational) is supported. The helm-values refutations [ev-41d780f6ab39][ev-ad95ec08c00b] apply to P1's subject and change, not to the consequence.
